body.summary: Julian and Ingrid's upbeat divorce party unravels spectacularly when Austin proposes to Hayley, sparking wedding chaos, creative tensions and post-split jealousy that turn their "good split" into fresh family turmoil.

show.name: Austin
show.summary: When much-loved children's author Julian Hartswood inadvertently causes a social media storm, his career and that of his illustrator wife Ingrid appears to be over. That is until Austin, the neurodivergent son that Julian never knew existed, turns up out of the blue. Could embracing this modern nuclear family be Julian's route back from cancellation? Will Ingrid forgive him for being such a pompous shit? One thing is for certain: if Julian thinks Austin is going to be a push over, he's in for a rude awakening.

body.name: Episode 2
body.summary: Julian's budget-saving wedding plan backfires as Austin dreams big, Hayley hides her wealthy family, and new doubts surface. A move to Australia exposes secrets, strained relationships and Ingrid's uncertain romance.

show.name: 16 лет и 9 месяцев
show.summary: The main character Tonya is 16 years old, she is an excellent student, is engaged in dancing and is crazy about the main handsome boy of the school, Semyon. To please him, Tonya tries to appear older and lies that she has been dating guys for a long time. But for Semyon, a date with Tonya is just entertainment, and for Tony it's the first time. In a couple of weeks, she finds out that she is pregnant. The girl cannot admit to anyone what happened and finds herself all alone in front of the most difficult choice. Tony's classmate Mitya suddenly becomes the only one who lends a shoulder. Under the yoke of condemnation from parents and the public, the heroine will have to go through a difficult path.

Set in the East End of London, the show focuses on the tensions between love and family with stories ranging from hard-hitting social issues, to personal, human tragedies. And there's plenty of funny moments too. 

Classic characters old and new across thousands of episodes have shared a drink in The Queen Vic, shed tears of despair or joy, sat on Arthur's bench in the Square... and at some point or other they probably crossed paths with Ian Beale.

show.name: Peelers: The PSNI for Real
show.summary:
Stephen Nolan joins officers from the Police Service of Northern Ireland as they patrol the streets of Belfast in Peelers: The PSNI for Real.

The series reflects the realities of 24/7 policing and its many challenges – including street disorder, substance abuse and domestic violence.

It also gives viewers a revealing sense of what it's like to be a police officer and the teamwork that's required in fast-changing and often uncertain situations.

show.summary: Emmerdale is a British soap focusing on the lives of several families and locals living around an estate, a farm and the nearby village in the Yorkshire Dales. It is the second longest British soap in television history since airing its first episode on ITV in 1972, as 'Emmerdale Farm', the show was renamed in 1989.

show.name: Love Island Australia
show.summary:
Taking the hottest international reality show format right now and unleashing it on 9GO!, the multi-million-dollar stripped format commission, Love Island Australia, will see sexy young Aussie singles on the lookout for romance, jetting off to a summer paradise to find love in the sun in Spain.

Not only must they must choose their partner wisely and stay the course as sexy new singles enter the island, but they also must win the hearts of the public, convincing them – and themselves – that their newfound love is real.

Throughout weeks of dates, challenges, eliminations and sexy new singles, all in front of our eyes, viewers will get to decide who they want to stay, who they want to boot, and ultimately who they want to crown the hottest couple on Love Island Australia. The winning couple are handed a pot of money to start their new lives together, but there's a catch: one is given the chance to share the money or walk away with it all for them self. Were they after love or money all along?

show.name: When I Meet the Moon
show.summary: The socially anxious Yun Li applies for a postgraduate program in Nanwu to prove her independence to her father. A day before the semester begins, she is invited to a local virtual reality (VR) center as a video creator. There, she reunites with Fu Shize, the genius and her high school crush. She gradually opens up, and, with the help of others, goes all out to court her dream man, winning him over with her warmth and radiance. However, amid the loving moments, their differing perspectives eventually lead to a breakup. When she goes abroad, his deeply suppressed trauma is brought to the forefront. To win her back, he gets back on his feet, leading his team to new heights in scientific research. When she returns to China, he pursues her relentlessly, and the two overcome their differences and rekindle their love.

show.name: 10's Late News
show.summary:
Ursula Heger, a senior journalist at 10 News First, will anchor the newly reintroduced news bulletin. Having been with the network since 2011, Heger has covered significant events, including the Ukraine conflict, the demise of Queen Elizabeth II, and other critical global stories.

Channel 10 states the bulletin aims to offer viewers a detailed wrap-up of the day's major stories, delivered in a digital-first format that allows audiences to tune in from any device, at their convenience.

show.name: The Silent Storm
show.summary: In 1994, tax auditor Ouyang Xu, criminal investigator Yan Ping'an, and Zhou Haiyang—who was searching for his missing wife—met through a counterfeit invoice case in Chunjiang City. Under the tide of the times, the three experienced vastly different circumstances, and their fates gradually diverged. Years later, Operation Grain Rain brings them together again—but the brothers of old now stand on opposite sides. Ouyang Xu faces off against the tax fraud ring led by Zhou Haiyang and the protective umbrella behind it, caught in a painful choice between emotion and the law. Starting from a single invoice, he tears away the veil of greed and ultimately eliminates evil, safeguarding justice.

show.name: Midnight Diner: Tokyo Stories
show.summary: In a back alley of a busy district sits a small eatery called Meshiya, referred to by its patrons as the Midnight Diner. The little joint, which the Master runs by himself, is open only from midnight to 7:00 AM. The menu consists only of a pork miso soup set, beer, saké and shochu, but the Master's policy is to make whatever his customers request. Tonight, like every other night, a menagerie of customers flock to the Midnight Diner, where the bonds among the Master, his food and the patrons set the stage for humorous and sometimes wistful episodes of human drama that feed both the belly and the soul.

But Madam, a self-proclaimed boss, soon discovers that more money and more power means more problems. Will Madam retain reign as she navigates this dangerous and sexy society? Will the sensuous world of exotic dancing cost Madam her queendom and potentially her life?

show.name: Rivals
show.summary: Rivals dives headfirst into the cut-throat world of independent television in 1986, where the shoulder pads are big and ambitions even bigger. In the fictional upper-class county of Rutshire, a long-standing rivalry between two powerful men is about to boil over: ex-Olympian, Member of Parliament, and notorious womaniser Rupert Campbell-Black, and his Rutshire neighbour Tony Baddingham, controller of the independent TV franchise Corinium Television. As tensions rise and rivalries deepen, there are spilled secrets, forged alliances, and snatched liaisons that draw wives, lovers, colleagues, friends, and families into their battle.

show.name: Where's Wanda?
show.summary: Where's Wanda? tells the story of Dedo and Carlotta Klatt, who are desperate to locate their missing 17-year-old daughter Wanda, who disappeared months ago without a trace. When the police fail to find her, the family takes matters into their own hands, obtaining surveillance devices with the help of their tech-savvy son Ole. Disguising themselves as employees of an electrical company, they bug first their neighborhood and then half their suburb, finding out that behind closed doors none of their neighbors are who they pretend to be.

show.name: Against the Gods
show.summary: Mythical Abode Mountain, Cloud's End Cliff, the most dangerous of Azure Cloud Continent's four deadly areas. Cloud's End Cliff's base is known as the Grim Reaper's Cemetery. Over countless years, the number of people that have fallen off this cliff is too high to count. None of them, even three stronger than god masters, whose power could pierce the heavens, have been able to return alive. However, a boy that's being chased by various people because he alone holds a priceless treasure jumps off the cliff, but instead of dying he wakes up in the body of a boy with the same name in another world. This is the story of a boy wielding the Sky Poison Pearl, cultivating the strength to oppose heaven and earth, a lord overlooking the world. —Novel Updates

show.summary: Ye Bufan, a junior student, tried to scam a car to raise medical expenses for his mother. Unexpectedly, he encountered a female driver who did not play by the rules. After being hit, Ye Bufan accidentally traveled to a fantasy world and obtained the inheritance of ancient medicine. From then on, he mastered medical skills, practiced martial arts, and won the favor of countless beautiful women.

body.name: Chip Off the Old Butch
body.summary: Santi makes his long-awaited pro debut while Pryce takes a road trip to visit his former mentor.

show.name: Stick
show.summary: Pryce Cahill is an over-the-hill, ex-pro golfer whose career was derailed prematurely 20 years ago. After the collapse of his marriage and getting fired from his job at an Indiana sporting goods store, Pryce hedges his bets, and future, entirely on a troubled 17-year-old golf phenom named Santi. Stick is a heartfelt, feel-good comedy about a found family and their relationships set within the world of golf as it's never been shown before.

show.name: WWE Evolve
show.summary: WWE Evolve will introduce viewers to the most intense and charismatic prospects recruited from college athletics and independent wrestling as they strive to build their in-ring careers and elevate their personas. WWE Evolve will prominently feature talent from WWE's world-class Performance Center in Orlando, Fla., and WWE ID, a first-of-its-kind developmental program.

show.name: Teach me, Touch me
show.summary: Dumped by his ex for being "too vanilla in bed," Gear decides to reinvent himself into someone confident and irresistible. To make it happen, he seeks out Kanthee, a top-tier playboy and charismatic luxury car mogul, to teach him the art of passion. As these intimate lessons unfold, their intense proximity blossoms into an uncontrollable bond. Kanthee discovers Gear's gentle, intriguing side, while Gear glimpses the genuine heart beneath Kanthee's playboy persona. When the line between lessons and feelings blurs, this thrilling connection might just end in falling in love. One came eager to learn, but the other ended up teaching way beyond the curriculum... In the end, who will fall first?

show.name: American Pulse
show.summary: American Pulse is an hour showcasing reporting from the vast network of CNN affiliates across the country.

show.name: The Body
show.summary: After a dance-team initiation goes wrong, a group of badly behaved Catholic school girls begin having prophetic visions that set off mass hysteria in their town.

body.name: Episode 5
body.summary: Empress Navier is shocked when her husband seeks divorce to wed his mistress; refusing defeat, she allies with Prince Heinrey, risking all to reclaim her throne and outshine her ex amid palace intrigue and romance.

show.name: The Remarried Empress
show.summary: Beloved Empress Navier of the Eastern Empire has built and led a prosperous land alongside her husband, Emperor Sovieshu. One day her world is shattered when the emperor brings Rashta, a runaway slave, back to the palace with the intention of making her his mistress. But even as the threat of a broken future looms over her, Navier refuses to let her emotions sway her, and when Prince Heinrey, a rival leader of the Western Kingdom, shows interest in her, Navier will make a life-changing decision to rewrite her destiny.

show.name: Built in Love
show.summary: Soul is a skilled architect. Xinxin is a successful Feng Shui master. When these two women with polar opposite personalities are hired to build a house together for its homeowners, a battle between them ensues. But will there be space for love to bloom?

show.name: My Secret Boyfriends
show.summary: Smart, clever, and resourceful, Dan worked hard to overcome being poor. But his cheap ways are getting on the last nerve of his coworker Saint who hates him! After an incident with his own impoverished parents, Dan is suddenly growing closer to Saint while balancing feelings for his former tutor, James. With mixed emotions and unspoken secrets, will Dan be rich with love or fall back into poverty?

show.name: Rett skal være rett
show.summary: Humorous guessing game where Olli Wermskog invites famous guests to place events and things in the correct order.

show.name: New Boyfriend
show.summary: A story about the love and relationships of people in an office, a place that is not only a workplace but also a place where someone's feelings are made clear.

show.name: Raised by Demons: Panda Li
show.summary: The story follows Li Xiongmao, a human boy raised by the demon race, who is ordered by his master to leave the Black and White Mountain to kill three enemies who destroyed the demon race. In the process of investigating the truth, he gradually uncovers the story of the conflict between humans and demons, the secrets of the dynasty, and the mystery of his own destiny.

show.name: ChiaroScuro
show.summary: Cosmo Speranza is the best art advisor in the business. He can tell whether a work of art is genuine or fake from even the smallest detail. An ability that proves useful when he finds himself working with Rome's Mobile Squad and Inspector Angelo Tiberi. The two are forced to work side by side, discovering that they make an unlikely yet highly effective investigative duo because, just like a painting, a crime scene can also be a forgery. And no one is better than Cosmo at spotting the clues that can bring down the house of cards built by a killer. But when a painting depicting his childhood home is found at a crime scene, it doesn't take Cosmo long to realise that the killer is speaking directly to him, prompting him to reopen the investigation into his father's suicide. A journey between past and present, where it seems impossible to tell truth from fiction.

show.name: La Ley de Alicia
show.summary: Alicia watches her life come undone when her husband, Aurelio, is found guilty and imprisoned for corruption, after videos surface implicating him in a sex scandal. With her family under public scrutiny, she decides to return to the legal profession after 20 years and rebuild her career to move forward. As she tries to reclaim her professional standing and support her teenage children in this new reality, Alicia begins to question what she wants out of life. A reunion with a past love and changes in her relationship with Aurelio will force her to make a decision: return to the life she once knew, or build a new one on her own terms.

show.name: The Rules
show.summary: A man takes a night-shift job at a mysterious convenience store, where employees must follow a strict set of strange rules. Breaking these rules can unleash terrifying supernatural events, forcing him to confront the dark secrets surrounding the store.

show.name: Reincarnated as a Sword
show.summary: Reincarnated as a sentient weapon with memories of his past life, but not his name, a magical sword saves a young beastgirl from a life of slavery. Fran, the cat-eared girl, becomes his wielder, and wants only to grow stronger, while the sword wants to know why he is here. Together, the strange duo's journey has only just begun!

show.summary: As markets open and the day's biggest stories take shape, anchor Christine Romans will translate breaking developments, politics, global news and the economy to help viewers stay informed and understand what's next. The two-hour program will also feature segments on finance, business, technology, AI and other consequential topics, leveraging Romans' role as NBC News' chief business correspondent.

show.name: Days of Our Lives
show.summary:
Days of our Lives is set in the fictitious Midwestern town of Salem. The core families are the Bradys, the Hortons and the DiMeras, and the multi-layered storylines involve elements of romance, adventure, mystery, comedy and drama.

Beginning on September 12, 2022, DAYS became exclusive to streaming on Peacock.

show.summary: NBC News provides viewers with up-to-the-minute national and international news.

show.name: Temps de chien
show.summary: Antoine Meilleur is a veterinarian and star of hit TV shows. He also owns a veterinary hospital and a veritable empire of pet products. But his whole world suddenly turns upside down the day he is plunged into a scandal against his will.

body.name: Thanksgiving Party Two
body.summary: As the women grapple with the aftermath of the Thanksgiving from Hell, a shocking secret threatens to change everything.

show.name: All's Fair
show.summary: A team of female divorce attorneys leave a male-dominated firm to open their own powerhouse practice. Fierce, brilliant, and emotionally complicated, they navigate high-stakes breakups, scandalous secrets, and shifting allegiances—both in the courtroom and within their own ranks. In a world where money talks and love is a battleground, these women don't just play the game—they change it.

show.name: Chris Harrison's the Vow
show.summary: Follows single men and women seeking traditional, marriage-minded partnerships built on commitment and shared values as they embark on a relationship journey with real-world compatibility tests and eliminations.

show.name: ABC News Live Reports
show.summary: ABC News Live Reports is the rare national newscast based in Los Angeles, in what the network is billing as an "outside the Beltway" focus on politics for the 2024 election cycle.

body.name: Episode 1
body.summary: Fran Da Silva's ordinary life is torn apart when online whispers position her as a serial killer's accomplice. As she struggles to understand why she has become a target, Fran learns there are other women facing the same accusation - and it's time for them to clear their names.

show.name: Hunting Alice Bell
show.summary: Alice Bell is a former nurse, and also the lover, and accomplice, of a notorious anaesthetist serial killer. She is presently living in Britain under a new identity. When, online, Fran Da Silva is accused of being Alice Bell, her happy family life implodes in a wave of mob hate. Then she discovers she's not the only woman to suffer this fate. Fran and the other accused women band together to fight back and clear their names. But as they battle to prove their innocence, what if one of the group is lying - and is the real Alice Bell…?

body.name: Episode 2
body.summary: Fran finds solace in meeting the other accused women. What begins as a cautious meeting between strangers quickly grows into an unexpected source of strength and solidarity. It's clear that the consequences of viral misinformation run deep. Meanwhile, the conspiracy surrounding Alice Bell continues to gather momentum, led by the hateful voice of True Crime Buster. But little do the women know, the anonymous online troll is close to Dr Jason Nash and is willing to do his bidding. When opportunity comes knocking for a TV interview, the women take their first steps toward standing together publicly. But they quickly learn that unity could provide their greatest protection - or their biggest risk.
